content:
Content type
Returns vulnerability details for a specific vulnerability instance.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the WAS.TOGGLE_WAS.USE  custom role privilege. Additionally,
requires the Can View [16] scan permission. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the vulnerability instance. To determine the UUID of a
vulnerability, use either the POST /was/v2/vulnerabilities/search endpoint
or the POST /was/v2/scans/{scan_id}/vulnerabilities/search endpoint.
